During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] undertook an undercover '''mission''' to [[Zygerria]] to rescue the [[Togruta]]n population of the [[planet]] [[Kiros]] from [[Zygerrian]] [[Slavery|slavers]]. Although the initial infiltration was successful, their mission on Zygerria ended with the [[Jedi]] being defeated, and with Kenobi and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] being captured and forced into slavery at the [[Kadavo slave processing facility]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic" />
